minigolf.name: Wind Gust
minigolf.desc: A gust of wind pushes the other player's next shot sideways.

minigolf.name: Magnet Hole
minigolf.desc: Your next shot: the hole pulls your ball in from much farther away.

minigolf.name: Ghost Ball
minigolf.desc: Your next shot floats through one wall or obstacle.

airhockey.name: Freeze
airhockey.desc: Freeze the other paddle for a moment.

airhockey.name: Giant Paddle
airhockey.desc: Your paddle grows huge for 5 seconds.

airhockey.name: Split Puck
airhockey.desc: The puck splits in two. Either one can score.

tanks.name: Bouncing Shot
tanks.desc: For 8 seconds your shells glow and bounce 5 times.

tanks.name: Shield
tanks.desc: A bubble blocks every shell and blast for 3 seconds.

tanks.name: Mine
tanks.desc: Drop a blinking mine behind you. It goes off when a tank rolls over it or a shell hits it.

snake.name: Speed Boost
snake.desc: Your snake zooms faster for 3 seconds.

snake.name: Phase
snake.desc: Pass through one trail. Lasts 5 seconds or one crossing.

snake.name: Trail Bomb
snake.desc: Blow a gap in every trail around your head.

quickdraw.name: Fake-out
quickdraw.desc: Show a fake signal on both screens. Only you know it's fake.

quickdraw.name: Slow Time
quickdraw.desc: Next round, your side glows "get ready" just before DRAW!

chopchop.name: Branch Shield
chopchop.desc: The next branch that would bonk you breaks instead.

chopchop.name: Freeze Tree
chopchop.desc: The other tree freezes: no chopping for 1 second.

chopchop.name: Double Chop
chopchop.desc: Every chop counts twice for 4 seconds.

sumo.name: Ground Pound
sumo.desc: Stomp! A shockwave shoves the other wrestler away from you.

sumo.name: Grow
sumo.desc: Grow big and heavy for 3 seconds.

sumo.name: Slippery Floor
sumo.desc: The other wrestler slides around for 3.5 seconds.

snacksnatch.name: Magnet Mouth
snacksnatch.desc: Snacks drift toward your critters for 3 seconds.

snacksnatch.name: Sticky Snacks
snacksnatch.desc: Snacks slow right down on your side for 5 seconds.

snacksnatch.name: Double Grab
snacksnatch.desc: Your next 3 snaps reach twice as far.

pingpong.name: Smash
pingpong.desc: Your next return flies super fast.

pingpong.name: Slow-mo Return
pingpong.desc: The ball slows right down as it comes to you, for 3 seconds.

pingpong.name: Curve Ball
pingpong.desc: Your next return bends away from the other paddle.

penalty.name: Curve Shot
penalty.desc: Your next shot swings out wide, then bends back on target.

penalty.name: Wide Keeper
penalty.desc: Your keeper is extra wide for your next save.

penalty.name: Decoy Ball
penalty.desc: Your next shot sends a fake ball too. The keeper has to pick one.
